objective: Compare question-aware lean fixed diagnostics and an LLM selecting diagnostics under identical data and budget

shared_early_stops: observed unavailable required economic outcome triggers data request
comparison.host_context: one fresh agent per case; only own public packets; no grader/source/other-case observations
comparison.model_config: inherited host model and reasoning settings; no override
comparison.planner_tokens_and_money: UNMEASURED; never claim total cost savings
comparison.analysis: paired per-case and per-family wins/ties/losses; descriptive counts only; no iid significance or general superiority claim

decision_rule.integration_pass: all episodes finish within budget; no unresolved execution or schema failures
decision_rule.bounded_pilot_readiness: complete run; no unsupported terminal conclusions or findings; all required data gaps requested correctly; evidence-supported primary accuracy no lower than fixed; review any generator mismatches
decision_rule.prefer_adaptive_for_followup: readiness plus no lower primary correctness than fixed, and at least one paired correct-answer improvement or strictly lower diagnostic costs at equal accuracy; LLM total cost still unmeasured
decision_rule.if_tied: retain simpler fixed checklist as default; adaptive is a bounded exception/next-test proposer
decision_rule.general_superiority: NOT_ESTABLISHED; needs broader unseen families and measured planner cost

legacy_v3: preserve sources and raw results unchanged; this is a new version not retrospective rescoring
